topic: Credible overlooked markets and non-geographic growth channels for Integra Dental Design (Bellevue, WA): PNW secondary metros, Vancouver BC/Canada, scanner-platform directories, product-shaped national niches, VA/IHS contracts, and equipment-sales geography, ranked by realism for a 6-person lab with $2,000-$9,000 cash.
summary:
RANKING (most to least realistic for a 6-person lab with no credit line), with the evidence that drives each call.

1. Lab-to-lab digital manufacturing sold nationally (ti bars, custom Ti abutments, full-arch zirconia, mill-only). FACTS: published lab-to-lab price anchors exist and Integra's Bear Milling list sits at or below the bottom of them: Mabel Dental Lab (OH) lab-to-lab Jan 2026 lists Ti custom abutment $119, milled Ti bar/framework $699, printed model $8-16; Vulcan Custom Dental lists custom Ti abutments $179-199 and Ti bars $499/$749/$899 plus $100 design; ROE's 2026 retail fee schedule lists a Ti bar at $825; Cera-Tech retail Ti OD bars $1,295-2,145. Integra's $299 std/$399 rush Ti bar and $22 mill-only zirconia are therefore price-leading, which is a margin risk, not a demand problem. LMT's 2025 State-of-the-Industry coverage reports growth in subcontracting between labs. ESTIMATE: two-way parcel cost is the real friction; Mabel charges $9 per UPS label each way, so sub-$65 items (night guards, single printed models) are marginal to ship. This is the channel that monetizes 90%-idle mills with zero new capex.

2. Scanner-platform directories (zero cash, geography-irrelevant). FACTS: 3Shape advertises ">20,000 partner labs" and a public "Find a lab" page; Unite lets labs create a marketing profile visible to practices worldwide. Medit Link's Partners page lets clinics search labs by name/address, ranks results by order volume within the map region, and Medit (Jan 2024) explicitly invites labs to complete a profile "to be showcased to clinics worldwide"; Integra already won Harmony Dental (Eugene) this way. Dentsply Sirona retired Connect Case Center for dentists on Nov 15, 2025; DS Core's free tier covers ordering and has a searchable lab directory, and labs can invite dentists and propose themselves as preferred lab. Align's iTero "certified laboratory" program is free and includes a "Lab Placement Program." UNKNOWN: no platform publishes lab win-rates; LMT's 2026 marketing survey shows only 35% of labs even track where new accounts come from. Treat as necessary hygiene, not a growth engine.

3. VA VISN 20 contracts. FACTS: Puget Sound dental prosthetics PO 36C26025P0440, up to $2,115,384 over 5 years, awarded Feb 2025 to Keating Dental Arts (Irvine, CA), 6 bids; Boise 36C26025P1055, $443,485 base year + 6-month option, awarded Jul 24, 2025 to Keating; Roseburg/Eugene fixed prosthetics 36C26026Q0529 awarded 2026 to Keating at $2,190,455 (5-year); Spokane Mann-Grandstaff removable sources-sought Aug 2024. All are total small-business set-asides (NAICS 339116, 500 employees). Requirements seen: full-service (fixed + removable + implant, plus maxillofacial/surgical at Puget Sound), contractor-provided pickup/delivery to multiple clinics, FDA/Buy American compliance, high-noble alloy default, 14-business-day turnaround, same-day repairs/relines, Hanau articulators. No NADL CDL requirement appears in VISN 20 notices; VISN 21's San Francisco sources-sought asks for 3 CDTs and a 60-mile radius. A SoCal lab winning Seattle/Boise/Roseburg shows distance is not disqualifying; Integra's gap is removable scope. Realistic entry: team with a removable lab (e.g., Stomadent, Meridian ID) or subcontract local pickup/repairs to the incumbent; watch the Boise recompete (base year ended ~Jul 2026) and the Spokane removable solicitation.

4. PNW secondary metros reachable by ground. FACTS: WA 5,597 dentists, OR 2,750, ID 1,090, MT 650, AK 580 (ADA HPI 2024 via KFF). WSDA 2025 membership report: Spokane 342 members at 58.6% market share, Benton (Tri-Cities) 129 at 54.9%, Yakima 125 at 61.1%, Walla Walla 54 at 66.1%. Idaho SWIDS (Ada/Elmore/Boise/Valley) 303 members in 2021; Idaho Panhandle (CdA) 138. ODA: 1,989 members = 51.5% of active Oregon dentists (2024). ESTIMATES: Spokane district ~584 dentists, Tri-Cities ~235, Yakima ~205 (members/share); Boise area ~400-500; Portland metro ~1,200-1,700; Anchorage ~230-280. Incumbents are everywhere: Aurum Group's US lab is headquartered in Spokane (group 80-90 staff, reps cover WA/OR/ID/MT); NDX has labs in Issaquah and Vancouver WA; Portland has Artisan, Assured, and O'Brien (11 CDTs, ISO 9001/DAMAS); Boise directories list ~20 labs including Stomadent's 7,000 sq ft facility; Anchorage directories list ~15 labs (some likely stale) including Trinity (CDT-owned) and Evo Dental Milling. No evidence any of these metros is underserved. Transit (ESTIMATE from FedEx's published 1-5 business-day ground rule and zone distance; FedEx's map tool blocks crawlers): 1 day to Portland/Salem/Spokane/CdA/Tri-Cities/Yakima; 2 days to Boise/Eugene/Bend/Missoula; 2-3 days to Bozeman/Billings; Anchorage FedEx Ground 3-7 days (FACT, service guide), with 2Day (3 days for certain AK ZIPs) and Priority Overnight available.

5. Product niches shipped nationally. FACTS: Glidewell Comfort H/S bite splint $80/arch, Comfort3D $90, soft nightguard $56, 4 days in lab; Mabel lab-to-lab hard/soft $65; X Dental retail hard/soft $145; Hiossen $150; Cera-Tech $220-235; Essix/clear retainers $44-95; printed models $8-38; surgical guides $160-375 full-service, $60-119 print-only; custom Ti abutment retail $318-420. Sleep appliances (SomnoMed, ProSomnus) retail $1,800-2,400 to patients and require FDA-cleared designs; dentist-level fees not published. Night guards are a commodity under Glidewell's $80 ceiling; realistic only as add-on to existing accounts.

6. Equipment-sales geography. FACTS: CBP 2023 dental lab establishments: CA 734, FL 424, NY 299, TX 277, IL 202, GA 175, WA 175, NC 155, MI 128, PA 126, OH 126, UT 111, TN 77; US total 4,782, down 146 from 2022. ARUM's published US dealer list: Axsys (Wixom MI), Doowon USA (Lansdale PA), Megacis (Anaheim), Decsta (Irvine), Imagine USA (Fullerton), ARUM Dentistry USA (Irvine); no listed dealer in TX, FL, NY, IL, GA, NC, UT or the PNW/Mountain West (Integra itself is not listed). Shows: Lab Day Chicago Feb 25-27, 2027 (largest); Lab Day West May 14-15, 2027, Garden Grove (1,600+ attendees in 2026; ~25 miles from the owner's father in Aliso Viejo); Lab Day East was Sep 26, 2026 (Tarrytown NY). Exhibitor fees not found.

7. Vancouver BC/Canada: NOT realistic as a prosthesis exporter. FACTS: Health Canada's letter to Canadian dental regulators states dental restoratives and dentures are medical devices, that labs/practitioners may not import unlicensed Class II-IV devices, and that devices sold by foreign manufacturers directly to health care facilities need a Canadian MDL; Ontario's RCDSO (Sep 26, 2024) tells dentists importing prostheses to confirm the foreign lab holds a licence. A Class II MDL fee is only CAD $643 (Apr 2026), but Health Canada has required an MDSAP certificate for every Class II-IV licence since Jan 1, 2019; MDSAP typically costs US$20-50k initial plus US$10-30k/yr surveillance (consultant estimates), exceeding Integra's annual cash. Tariff 9021.29 is duty-free (MFN and CUSMA); artificial teeth are zero-rated (ETA Sch. VI Pt II s.11) and non-taxable at import (Sch. VII s.6/s.213); BC PST exempts prescription dental appliances. But each BC dentist would be importer of record needing CARM/BN15 registration and paying CAD $17-135 courier entry fees per parcel. Demand signal is weak and old (DIAC 2009: 2.3% of Canadian dentists sent Rx outside Canada); Frontier Dental Lab (CA) chose to open a Vancouver BC facility rather than ship. The only clean cross-border product is CAD design files, which are not devices.

KEY UNKNOWNS: metro-level CBP lab counts (Census API requires a key); BLS/ADA dentist counts by metro; exact FedEx Ground days from 98007; Lab Day exhibit pricing; SomnoMed/ProSomnus dentist fees; IHS Portland Area/Alaska dental-lab solicitations (none found; Buy Indian Act ISBEE preference applies elsewhere); any post-2006 Health Canada written position treating lab prostheses as Part 2 custom-made devices rather than licensable devices.

findings.claim: VA Puget Sound dental prosthetics contract is worth up to $2,115,384 over 5 years and went to a Southern California lab
findings.detail: PO 36C26025P0440 awarded Feb 2025 by VISN 20 to Keating Dental Arts (Irvine, CA); total small business set-aside, NAICS 339116, PSC 6520, 6 bids received; scope: removable, fixed, maxillofacial, surgical and implant prosthetics with contractor pickup/delivery to Seattle, Tacoma and Mt Vernon clinics. Backlog reported $1,734,410. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Boise VA Medical Center dental prosthetics award was $443,485 for a base year plus 6-month option, also to Keating Dental Arts
findings.detail: Award 36C26025P1055 dated Jul 24, 2025 (solicitation 36C26025Q0698), Network Contracting Office 20 (Vancouver, WA); small business set-aside; scope removable, fixed and implant prosthetics with pickup/delivery to Boise clinics. Base period one year with 52.217-8 six-month extension, implying a recompete in 2026-27. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: VA Roseburg/Eugene fixed prosthetics (36C26026Q0529) is a 5-year, 42-line-item small-business set-aside awarded at $2,190,455 to Keating Dental Arts
findings.detail: Solicitation posted Apr 10, 2026, quotes due Apr 24, 2026; requirements: full-service lab integrating fixed and implant-supported prostheses, FDA standards and Buy American Act, high noble metal default, 14-business-day turnaround, same-day repairs/relines by 3:30 PM, pickup/delivery 8-4 M-F to Roseburg and Eugene, Hanau semi-adjustable articulators; evaluation on technical capability, past performance, price. Award notice shows $2,190,455 total value. No NADL CDL requirement is stated. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: VA Spokane (Mann-Grandstaff) issued a sources-sought for removable dental prosthetics in Aug 2024
findings.detail: Notice 36C260-24-AP-2327-Revised, NAICS 339116, posted 8/16/2024, responses due 8/30/2024; contractor to pick up impressions and removable prostheses from the Spokane dental clinic. No award record found in this research. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: A VA sources-sought in VISN 21 (San Francisco) shows the stricter end of VA requirements: 60-mile proximity, no subcontracting, at least 3 CDTs
findings.detail: 36C26127Q0002 (posted Jun 10, 2026): in-house fabrication within CONUS, no subcontracting/outsourcing, lab within 60 miles of both facilities, daily temperature-controlled courier, at least three Certified Dental Technicians, noble/high-noble alloys, FDA QS/GMP, ISO/ANSI/ADA compliance. VISN 20 notices reviewed did not impose a CDL/CDT requirement. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: IHS dental lab solicitations exist as small-business set-asides (NAICS 339116) but none were found for the Portland Area IHS or Alaska
findings.detail: Examples found: Navajo Area Kayenta KSUSOL2026-002 (presolicitation Nov 13, 2025; base + two option years; evaluation includes 'Professional Certifications'); Phoenix Area Fort Yuma IHS1519511 (RFQ Dec 19, 2025, multiple-award IDIQ, base + 4 options, one-year warranty, HIPAA, scanning/milling capability); Albuquerque Area Zuni 75H70725Q00052 (Feb 27, 2025) set aside first for Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises under the Buy Indian Act, requiring 5 years' experience. Southcentral Foundation's 2023 contracted-dental-services RFP excluded prosthetic and occlusal-guard services. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Health Canada's position is that foreign-made dental restoratives/dentures are medical devices requiring a Canadian medical device licence, and labs/practitioners may not import unlicensed Class II-IV devices
findings.detail: Health Canada letter to Canadian provincial/territorial dental associations, dental regulators, dental technicians and denturists: 'The Medical Devices Regulations prohibit dental laboratories or dental health care practitioners from importing certain types of medical devices (i.e., Class II, III and IV devices) that are not licensed in Canada. Dental tools... dental restoratives and dentures are considered to be medical devices.' and 'medical devices sold by foreign manufacturers directly to health care facilities are also required to have a valid Canadian Medical Device Licence.' Page is archived (2006) but remains Health Canada's only direct statement to dentistry found. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Ontario's dental regulator (RCDSO) tells dentists that imported prostheses must come from a Health Canada-licensed foreign lab
findings.detail: RCDSO news article: 'dentists who import dental prostheses from outside Canada must ensure that the offshore laboratory or manufacturer has a Class III licence that covers fabrication of crowns, bridges, dentures etc.' (RCDSO's class wording is imprecise, but the direction is that a Canadian MDL is required). No equivalent BCCOHP statement was found; BC's Oral Health Professionals Regulation (B.C. Reg. 134/2025) governs who may practise dental technology in BC, not imports. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: The 'custom-made device' route under Part 2 of Canada's Medical Devices Regulations is not a clean fit for lab-made crowns
findings.detail: MDR s.1 defines a custom-made device as one that 'differs from medical devices generally available for sale or from a dispenser'; Canadian dental technicians are 'dispensers' (members of a professional governing body entitled to make devices to a prescription), so a prescription crown is the paradigm dispenser product rather than a Part 2 device. Part 2 (s.69-78) only requires Health Canada authorization for Class III/IV custom-made devices, and persons importing/selling only Part 2 devices are MDEL-exempt (GUI-0016), which is why some labs assume no licence is needed; Health Canada's dentistry letter contradicts that assumption. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: A Canadian Class II device licence costs CAD $643 but requires an MDSAP certificate, mandatory since Jan 1, 2019
findings.detail: Health Canada fee table (effective Apr 1, 2026): Class II MDL application CAD $643 (CAD $632 in 2025-26); annual right-to-sell CAD $452; MDEL application CAD $5,519. Health Canada accepts only MDSAP certificates (not standalone ISO 13485) as QMS evidence for Class II-IV licences since 2019. Small-business remissions (50%, or 100% for a first application) exist for the fee but not for MDSAP auditing costs. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: MDSAP certification for a small manufacturer typically costs US$20,000-50,000 initially plus US$10,000-30,000 per year
findings.detail: Consultant estimates (MedDeviceGuide, Mar 2026): initial AO audit $20-50k, annual surveillance $10-25k/yr, recertification $15-35k, preparation consulting $15-60k, 3-year total $50-175k. PinnacleQMS (Apr 2026) gives implementation CA$30-95k and AO fees CA$18-45k. These are secondary sources, not quotes. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Dental prostheses enter Canada duty-free under tariff 9021.29 (MFN Free; CUSMA/UST Free)
findings.detail: Canadian Customs Tariff heading 9021 'Artificial teeth and dental fittings': 9021.21.00 artificial teeth and 9021.29.00 other, both MFN Free and Free under UST (United States Tariff). Crowns, bridges, partial frameworks and obturators are classified to 9021.29.00 in CBSA-derived rulings summarized by tariffs.wove.com. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: GST does not apply at import to artificial teeth (crowns, bridges, dentures) because they are zero-rated and therefore non-taxable importations
findings.detail: Excise Tax Act Schedule VI Part II s.11 zero-rates 'a supply of artificial teeth' (CRA: a crown replacing 50%+ of the anatomical surface qualifies); Schedule VII s.6 makes goods included in Parts I-IV and VIII of Schedule VI non-taxable importations under s.213 (GST Memorandum 300-8, GST status code 57). GST/HST still applies to brokerage fees. Note Axelrod v. The King (TCC 2022) treats the dentist's onward supply to the patient as an exempt service, which affects the dentist's ITCs, not the import. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: BC PST exempts dental appliances sold on a practitioner's prescription and dentures
findings.detail: Provincial Sales Tax Exemption and Refund Regulation (B.C. Reg. 97/2013) s.3(1)(h) dentures and (i) 'dental and optical appliances, if the appliances are sold on the prescription of a practitioner'; Bulletin PST 207 lists 'Dental appliances sold on prescription' as exempt. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Every BC dentist importing cases would need to be registered in CBSA's CARM portal with a BN15 importer account, and courier brokerage runs CAD $17-135 per parcel
findings.detail: CBSA: 'all importers need an account in the CARM Client Portal, a 9-digit business number and an RM import account'; CARM became the system of record Oct 21, 2024; broker-BN15 transition measures ended Dec 31, 2025. Courier entry-preparation schedules (CAD, by value for duty): UPS Standard CAD $19.10 ($40-60) to $134.55 ($1,600-2,500); FedEx Ground U.S.-to-Canada clearance entry fee CAD $17.25 ($40-60), $54 ($200-500), $62 ($500-1,000), $82 ($1,600-3,300); UPS disbursement fee greater of 3.7% or $7 when it advances duty/tax. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Canadian dentists historically sent only ~2% of prescriptions outside Canada, and US labs have chosen to open BC facilities rather than ship cross-border
findings.detail: DIAC survey (reported Aug 2010): of ~1,000 responding Canadian dentists, 2.3% sent denture prescriptions outside Canada in 2009, down from 4.6% in 2008. Frontier Dental Lab (El Dorado Hills/Sacramento, CA) lists a Vancouver, BC facility at 325 W 6th Ave; Protec (Vancouver, founded 1983, part of Canadian Dental Labs) serves 2,500+ dentists; Aurum (Calgary) runs the reverse model with a Spokane lab. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: 3Shape operates a public lab directory and claims more than 20,000 partner labs; Unite lets labs publish a marketing profile
findings.detail: 3Shape TRIOS page: 'scan-and-send to one of our more than 20,000 partner labs... We make it easy for you to find 3Shape partner labs' (FIND A LAB). 3Shape Unite launch release (Oct 27, 2021): 'provides a directory for dental labs to become more visible to dental practices around the world... labs can market their services with a profile they create'; Unite Cloud app FAQ: 'Lab connections' page where dentists 'find a lab to collaborate with'. Lab-side cost of listing not stated. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Medit Link's Partners search ranks labs by order volume within the map region and labs can publish a profile to be found by clinics
findings.detail: Medit Help Center (updated Apr 14, 2026): clinics 'search for Medit Link users based on their business name and/or address... Search results are listed by order volume within the region shown on the map'; both parties must opt into the partner list (My Info > Search Options). Medit blog (Jan 10, 2024): 'Clinics... can easily and quickly find a dental lab... through the Partners Page... create your Lab Profile to be showcased to clinics worldwide.' Partners feature is web-only. Integra's Harmony Dental (Eugene) account came via Medit Link (given). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Dentsply Sirona retired Connect Case Center for dentists on Nov 15, 2025; DS Core's free tier includes lab ordering and a searchable lab directory
findings.detail: Dentsply Sirona announced CCC retirement in most countries by Nov 15, 2025 (reported Apr 29, 2025), with a 'free account option for data transfers to labs' on DS Core. Secondary guides (2026) describe dentists adding labs via Practice > Preferred Labs > directory search by name/location, and labs inviting dentists and proposing themselves as preferred lab; file-sharing with non-digital dentists requires paid DS Core Light. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: iTero lab integration is free and includes a 'Lab Placement Program' and 'Lab Advantage Program' for doctor engagement
findings.detail: Align: 'Join our network of certified iTero laboratories free of charge'; 'As an iTero lab, you'll gain access to the caLABrate certification program, exocad & iTero integration... You'll also be eligible to participate in the Lab Advantage Program and the Lab Placement Program, giving you access to dedicated marketing and engagement opportunities.' Dentists add labs via MyiTero > Settings > My Labs (search by name or Company ID) or iTero Support; no lab-to-lab sending. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Straumann runs a 'Lab Finder' listing 'Straumann Original Ambassador' labs, and Neodent publishes a Practice Resource Guide naming partner labs
findings.detail: Straumann: 'Straumann Original Ambassadors are listed in our lab finder... an online platform where dentists can search for labs that meet the strict criteria for inclusion'; availability varies by country. Straumann's lab loyalty tiers are spend-based ($1,000 to $300,000+). Neodent's Practice Resource Guide lists labs (e.g., JB Dental Lab, Power Dental Studio) with a disclaimer that Straumann does not endorse providers. No published data on accounts won via rep referrals. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Only 35% of labs track where new accounts come from; one Boise lab attributes ~25% of referrals to office staff changing practices
findings.detail: LMT Marketing Survey (Apr 28, 2026): 68% of labs market to dentists; 29% set a budget (most spend 1-2% of revenue); 35% track results; 18% target new graduates differently (social media). Randy Leininger, Just Crowns (Boise, ID): 'about a quarter of our referrals come from [office managers, hygienists, assistants] recommending our services when they join a new practice.' No survey quantifies DentalTown/Facebook or alumni-network acquisition. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Glidewell sets the national night-guard price ceiling at $80 per arch (Comfort H/S) with 4-day in-lab time
findings.detail: Glidewell price page: Comfort H/S Bite Splint $80 (Twinpak $132), colored $85, Comfort3D printed $90, CLEARsplint $104, semiflexible nightguard $61, soft nightguard $56; 'Bite splints & retainers 4 working days in lab'. Riverside Dental Ceramics (Glidewell affiliate) mirrors $80/$90. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Independent lab night guard prices cluster $65 (lab-to-lab) to $145-235 (retail); clear retainers $44-95; printed models $8-38
findings.detail: Mabel lab-to-lab (Jan 2026): hard/soft $65, soft $35, hard acrylic $59, 3D-printed $49, printed model $8 quad/$12-16 arch, Essix $85+. X Dental retail (Aug 2025): hard/soft $145, clear retainer $44. ROE 2026: AdaptivFIT splint $69, hard splint $111, hard w/ memory liner $154, Essix $51, printed model $25. Cera-Tech 2025: Thermoflex $220, hard splint $235, Essix $95, printed model $20-30. Hiossen (Nov 2025): night guard $150 list/$100 package. Accessed 2026-10-12.
findings.value: $65-$235 night guard; $44-$95 clear retainer; $8-$38 printed model

findings.claim: Lab-to-lab price anchors for Integra's Bear Milling line: custom Ti abutment $119-199, milled Ti bar $499-899, versus Integra's $299/$399 bar
findings.detail: Mabel lab-to-lab Jan 2026: Ti custom abutment $119, zirconia abutment $139, CAD/CAM milled implant bar/framework (3+ implants) $699. Vulcan Custom Dental: custom Ti abutments $179 (from model) / $199 (from scan), Ti bars $499 (2 connections), $749 (3), $899 (4+), plus $100 design; screw-retained zirconia full arch $899 + parts. ROE 2026 retail: Ti bar $825; Riverside retail Ti abutment $318; Cera-Tech retail Ti abutment $420, OD bar $1,295-2,145. Integra's $299 standard Ti bar is 40% below the lowest lab-to-lab anchor found. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Surgical guide price anchors: $160-375 full-service, $60-119 print-only; full-arch guides $444-754
findings.detail: TrueGuide (Sep 2026): standard guide $279 for 2 sites, +$59/site, print-only $119; full-arch guide $579. ROE 2026: tooth-supported guide $315 + $43/implant; tissue-supported full-arch $444; bone-supported $664-754. Implant Concierge 2026: $325-375 tooth/tissue-borne, $450 bone-borne. X Dental: design+print $160, print-only $60. Hiossen OneGuide: $220 list/$130 package. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Oral sleep appliances retail to patients at roughly $1,800-2,400 and require FDA-cleared designs; dentist-level lab fees for SomnoMed/ProSomnus were not found
findings.detail: MedGrade lists SomnoMed Avant device price $1,800; Dentovex 2025 guide cites US custom MAD device cost $1,800-2,400 (CPT E0486 national average allowable ~$1,350). ProSomnus Rx form states 6-7 day turnaround plus shipping; prices not on the form. SomnoMed's US site does not publish dentist pricing. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: US dental labs cluster in CA (734), FL (424), NY (299), TX (277), IL (202); Washington has 175 establishments
findings.detail: Census County Business Patterns 2023 (released Jun 2025), NAICS 339116, as tabulated by PlainBizBench: US 4,782 establishments, 42,188 employees (down 146 establishments and 351 employees vs 2022); CA 734/9,086 emp; FL 424/2,569; TX 277/2,406; NY 299/2,217; IL 202/1,528; UT 111/1,321; TN 77/1,232; WA 175/1,142; PA 126/1,087; MI 128/1,079; GA 175; NC 155; OH 126. State counts for OR, ID, MT, AK and all metro counts were not retrievable (Census API requires a key; data.census.gov is script-rendered). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: ARUM's published US dealer network is concentrated in Michigan, Pennsylvania and Southern California, with no listed dealer in TX, FL, NY, IL, GA, NC, UT or the Pacific Northwest
findings.detail: ARUM Dentistry worldwide page lists for the USA: Axsys (Wixom, MI), Doowon USA (Lansdale, PA), Megacis (Anaheim, CA), Decsta (Irvine, CA), Imagine USA (Fullerton, CA), ARUM Dentistry USA Inc. (Irvine, CA); Canada: Apex on Tech (North York, ON). Integra is not listed despite its March 2026 dealer agreement. Axsys sells ARUM-based machines under the Versamill brand and claims exclusive modifications; Doowon sells stock ARUM. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: LMT LAB DAY West 2027 is May 14-15 in Garden Grove, CA (1,600+ attendees in 2026); LAB DAY Chicago 2027 is Feb 25-27; LAB DAY East 2026 was Sep 26 in Tarrytown, NY
findings.detail: LMT show pages: West 2027 at Hyatt Regency Orange County, 11999 Harbor Blvd, two exhibit halls; registration opens March 2027. West 2026 (May 15-16) drew 'more than 1,600 dental laboratory owners, managers, technicians and dentists', billed as the largest lab show on the West Coast. Chicago 2027 is the 42nd annual, 'Largest Dental Laboratory Show in the World', Hyatt Regency Chicago. East 2026 was a one-day show at Westchester Marriott. Exhibitor pricing not published on these pages. Garden Grove is roughly 25 road miles from Aliso Viejo/Laguna Beach. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Dentist supply by state (ADA HPI, 2024): WA 5,597; OR 2,750; ID 1,090; MT 650; AK 580; US 202,485
findings.detail: KFF State Health Facts table of professionally active dentists sourced from ADA HPI (June 2025 vintage representing year-end 2024). Ratios per 100,000: AK 78.4 (2nd highest in US), WA 70.3, OR 64.4, MT 57.2, ID 54.5 vs US 59.5. ADA HPI reports Idaho and Montana had net in-migration of dentists 2019-2024 (Idaho +49 dentists = 19% net migration rate). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Eastern Washington dentist counts can be derived from WSDA's 2025 component membership report: Spokane ~584, Tri-Cities (Benton) ~235, Yakima ~205, Walla Walla ~82
findings.detail: WSDA 2025 House of Delegates membership report lists members and market share by component: Spokane 342 members at 58.6%; Benton 129 at 54.9%; Yakima 125 at 61.1%; Walla Walla 54 at 66.1%; Seattle 1,504 at 44.9%. Dividing members by share gives the implied dentist universe (estimate). Spokane District covers Ferry, Stevens, Pend Oreille, Lincoln, Spokane, Adams and Whitman counties. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Boise-area organized dentistry had 303 members in 2021 (Ada/Elmore/Boise/Valley counties); Idaho Panhandle (Coeur d'Alene) 138
findings.detail: Idaho State Dental Association component page: Southwest Idaho Dental Society 303 members (2021); Idaho Panhandle 138; South Central 97; Southeast 88; Lewis-Clark 45. ISDA has 'over 900' members statewide against 1,090 Idaho dentists (ADA HPI 2024), so the Boise-area dentist universe is likely 400-500 (estimate). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Oregon Dental Association had 1,989 members in 2024, which it states is 51.5% of active Oregon dentists (~3,860 by ODA's denominator)
findings.detail: ODA 2024 Annual Report; ODA restructured components in 2024: Lane County merged with Southern Willamette into Coastal Cascades Dentist Society (Lane, Benton, Linn, part of Lincoln). Component-level counts for Multnomah/Clackamas/Washington (Portland), Marion-Polk (Salem) and Central Oregon (Bend) are not published. Note ODA's 3,860 'active' denominator exceeds ADA HPI's 2,750 professionally active count. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Spokane is the US headquarters of the Aurum Group's dental lab (Calgary-based, 80-90 staff group), with reps covering WA, OR, ID and MT
findings.detail: Aurum Group Spokane lab at 1320 N. Howard, Spokane 99201 (509-326-5885), full service incl. implants, ortho and OSA appliances, with online case portal and CE seminars; Aurum locations: Calgary, Ottawa, Moncton, Kelowna, Saskatoon, Spokane. Aurum's Spokane operations lead states he works with dentists 'in Washington, Oregon, Idaho and Montana'. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: National Dentex (NDX) has PNW labs in Issaquah, WA and Vancouver, WA; Portland has established independents (Artisan, Assured, O'Brien with 11 CDTs)
findings.detail: NDX Issaquah (640 NW Gilman Blvd; digital design and on-site milling); NDX Advanced Dental Technologies (11820 NE Crestwood Dr, Vancouver, WA). Artisan Dental Laboratory (Portland, 40+ years, full service incl. nightguards, sleep and ortho); Assured Dental Lab (Milwaukie, since 2001, serves US and Canada); O'Brien Dental Lab (Corvallis; 11 CDTs; ISO 9001:2015 and DAMAS). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Boise/Meridian has roughly 20 directory-listed dental labs including a 7,000 sq ft digital denture lab that sells to labs nationwide
findings.detail: Stomadent Dental Laboratory (Meridian, ID): 7,000 sq ft, 20+ years, 'reliable dental lab for hundreds of dental professionals and labs throughout the United States', serves ID/UT/WA/OR/CA/AZ. Others: Dental Designs Inc (Meridian, since 1980), Treasure Dental Lab (Boise; surgical guides, PMMA), Whitecap Dental Lab (Meridian; digital, ships nationally), McClure Dental Lab Design (Meridian; BruxZir authorized), Just Crowns (Boise). Boise-Local directory lists ~20 names (undated; completeness unverified). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Anchorage has at least two active digital labs and ~15 directory-listed labs; FedEx Ground to Alaska is 3-7 business days while 2Day and Priority Overnight are available
findings.detail: Trinity Dental Lab (4111 Minnesota Dr; CDT owner, 30 years) and Evo Dental Milling and Design (502 W Northern Lights; full-arch and implant focus) are active; a local directory lists ~15 labs (undated, some likely defunct). FedEx Service Guide: Ground 'Day-definite delivery in 1-5 business days (3-7 business days to and from Alaska and Hawaii)'; FedEx 2Day available in all 50 states with 3-day delivery for certain Alaska shipments; Priority Overnight 2 days for certain AK shipments. UPS Ground Seattle-Anchorage is cited as 2-3 days by a third-party guide. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Ground transit from Bellevue to PNW secondary metros is roughly 1 day to Portland/Salem/Spokane/CdA/Tri-Cities/Yakima, 2 days to Boise/Eugene/Bend/Missoula, 2-3 days to Bozeman/Billings
findings.detail: ESTIMATE: fedex.com's Ground service maps blocked crawlers (System Down/permission error), so days are inferred from FedEx's published 1-5 business-day distance-based rule and carrier zone tables (zone 2 ~0-150 mi = 1 day; zone 3 ~151-300 mi = 1-2 days; zone 4 ~301-600 mi = 2 days; zone 5 ~601-1,000 mi = 2-3 days). Road distances from Bellevue: Portland ~175 mi, Spokane ~280, Tri-Cities ~215, Yakima ~145, Boise ~500, Missoula ~475, Bozeman ~680, Billings ~820, Eugene ~285, Bend ~330. Verify at fedex.com/grd/maps for ZIP 98007. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Metro-level dental lab counts for Spokane, Boise, Portland and Anchorage could not be pulled from Census CBP; directory-based estimates are Spokane 8-15, Boise 15-25, Portland metro 40-70, Anchorage 8-15
findings.detail: ESTIMATE basis: WA statewide 175 CBP establishments (2023) scaled by population share (Spokane County ~7% of WA), the ~20-name Boise directory, ~15-name Anchorage directory (likely overstated by stale entries), and Oregon's lab base implied by the Pacific Northwest over-indexing noted in SUSB data (Acquisera). The Census API call returned 'Missing Key'. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: US dentists overwhelmingly prefer domestic, CDT-staffed labs and disclosure, which favors a US lab in national lab-to-lab and government work but is not evidence of unmet demand
findings.detail: Inside Dental Technology 2020 survey: 73% of dentists exclusively use outside labs; 12% knowingly send work overseas; 87% believe labs should register/disclose point of origin; 76% say CDT staffing is paramount or very important. NADL letter to FDA cites imports as a large share of crown and bridge; Dental Products Report (2017) quotes an estimate that ~40% of US restorations were imported. Accessed 2026-10-12.

unknowns: Metro-level counts of dental laboratories (NAICS 339116) for Spokane, Tri-Cities, Yakima, Boise, Portland, Eugene, Bend, Missoula, Bozeman, Billings and Anchorage: Census CBP has them but the API requires a key and data.census.gov is script-rendered; only state totals (WA 175) and national rankings were obtained.

Metro-level dentist counts for Portland, Salem, Eugene, Bend, Missoula, Bozeman, Billings and Anchorage: BLS OES metro pages were not parsed; ODA and Montana/Alaska societies do not publish component counts. Estimates given are population-share derived.
Exact FedEx Ground and FedEx 2Day transit days from ZIP 98007 to each metro: fedex.com's service maps blocked crawler access; days are inferred from FedEx's 1-5 day rule and zone distances.

Whether Health Canada has any written position after its 2006 letter that treats dentist-prescribed lab prostheses as Part 2 'custom-made devices' (no MDL) rather than licensable Class II devices; the regulation's 'differs from... a dispenser' wording and the 2006 letter both point to MDL being required, but no current FAQ was found.
Dentist-level (wholesale) lab fees for SomnoMed Avant/Herbst Advance and ProSomnus EVO devices; only patient-facing prices ($1,800-2,400) were found.
LMT LAB DAY West / Chicago exhibitor booth pricing and attendee counts for Chicago 2026/2027 (West 2026 attendance 1,600+ is known).

Whether any IHS Portland Area, Alaska Area or tribal health organization (ANTHC, SCF, Yakama, Confederated Tribes) has issued a dental laboratory services solicitation recently; none surfaced, and Buy Indian Act ISBEE preference seen in Albuquerque Area would disadvantage a non-Indian-owned lab.
Win-rate or account-acquisition data from 3Shape Unite, Medit Link, DS Core or iTero lab directories; none of the platforms publishes it.
Cost (if any) for a lab profile on 3Shape Unite beyond Integra's existing Dental System/Communicate subscription, and the price of the paid DS Core Light tier.
Identity and award value of the Spokane Mann-Grandstaff removable prosthetics contractor following the Aug 2024 sources-sought.

Whether Keating Dental Arts subcontracts local pickup/delivery/same-day repairs in Seattle/Tacoma/Mt Vernon or Boise (the solicitations required contractor-provided transportation), i.e., whether a local subcontracting opportunity exists.
Actual demand depth for lab-to-lab Ti bars at $299: the lowest published lab-to-lab anchor found is $499 (Vulcan, 2 connections); no data on volume elasticity at Integra's price.

cost_items.item: MDSAP certification (required for any Health Canada Class II-IV device licence) - initial audit and preparation
cost_items.basis: Consultant ranges for small manufacturers (MedDeviceGuide Mar 2026: AO initial audit $20-50k; PinnacleQMS Apr 2026: CA$18-45k AO fees plus CA$30-95k implementation). Excludes consulting ($15-60k) and internal time.

cost_items.item: Health Canada Class II medical device licence application fee
cost_items.basis: CAD $643 as of Apr 1, 2026 converted at ~0.73 USD/CAD; 50% small-business remission (100% for a first application) may apply. Annual right-to-sell CAD $452 (~US$330).

cost_items.item: Courier customs entry fee into Canada per parcel (paid by BC dentist as importer of record), typical case value CAD $200-500
cost_items.basis: FedEx Ground U.S.-to-Canada clearance entry fee CAD $54 for $200.01-500 value (~US$40); range CAD $17.25 ($40-60) to CAD $134.55 (UPS Standard, $1,600-2,500). Duty is 0% (9021.29) and GST is non-taxable at import for artificial teeth, but GST applies to the fee itself.

cost_items.item: Two-way parcel shipping per lab-to-lab case (negotiated small-lab rate)
cost_items.basis: Mabel Dental Lab charges $9 per UPS label each way for lab-to-lab cases; retail zone-2 UPS Ground for a 5 lb box is ~$14 one way (shippingcalculators.net). Erodes most margin on items under ~$65.

cost_items.item: FedEx Ground, Bellevue to Boise/Missoula (zone 4, ~1-3 lb lab box), one way
cost_items.basis: Retail zone-based ranges (zone 2 ~$14 for 5 lb; zone 4 ~15% more); fedex.com rate tool blocked. Account discounts would lower this.

cost_items.item: Listing/profile on scanner platforms (3Shape Unite, Medit Link Partners, DS Core free tier, iTero certified lab)
cost_items.basis: iTero: 'Join our network of certified iTero laboratories free of charge'; DS Core free Access tier includes ordering and directory; Medit Link partner profile is part of the account; 3Shape Unite profile is tied to the existing Communicate/Dental System account Integra already pays for. Marginal cash cost is effectively nil; nominal $1 used because no separate fee was found (not zero-cost in staff time).

cost_items.item: DS Core Light paid tier (needed only to share files with non-digital dentists)
cost_items.basis: Price not found on Dentsply Sirona pages; estimate based on comparable cloud lab-portal subscriptions. Not required for ordering/directory.

cost_items.item: Exhibit booth at LMT LAB DAY West (Garden Grove, May 14-15, 2027)
cost_items.basis: LMT does not publish exhibitor rates on the show pages; estimate from typical 10x10 booth pricing at regional dental lab trade shows plus badge/drayage. Attendance 1,600+ in 2026. Lodging cost near zero given family in Aliso Viejo.

cost_items.item: Attend (not exhibit) LMT LAB DAY Chicago, Feb 25-27, 2027 - travel for one person
cost_items.basis: Attendee registration is free per attendee reviews; estimate covers SEA-ORD airfare and 2-3 nights at/near Hyatt Regency Chicago.

cost_items.item: Health Canada MDEL (only if Integra acted as importer/distributor of others' devices in Canada; not needed for own licensed devices)
cost_items.basis: CAD $5,519 application and annual review fee (2026-27) at ~0.73; 25% small-business remission possible. Included for completeness; the realistic blocker is MDSAP, not MDEL.

cost_items.item: Reference: Boise VA dental prosthetics contract value (base year + 6-mo option)

Integra would need a removable partner.

Also a SoCal lab near the owner's family base.

targets.how_to_reach: Desk research only was performed; contact details are on keatingdentallab.com (not fetched). Approach as a subcontractor for VISN 20 logistics/overflow.

targets.decision_maker: Owner (20+ years in-office denture lab background per site)

targets.why: Active Anchorage digital labs; Alaska small labs face 3-7 day ground transit from any CONUS supplier, so a Seattle-based Ti-bar/full-arch/milling partner with 2Day or Alaska Air Cargo access (Integra holds TSA Known Shipper) has a structural edge over SoCal/Midwest milling centers.

targets.why: Established full-service Portland labs 1 ground day from Bellevue; candidates for lab-to-lab Ti bars and overflow zirconia milling (neither advertises in-house metal milling).

targets.why: Implant companies list qualifying labs in dentist-facing finders; Integra's in-progress TRI certification and any Straumann/Neodent original-component purchases can be converted into listings that reps point dentists to. Evidence of program existence is solid; evidence of conversion is anecdotal.
